test_overview: Regression test of core MVP visitor functionality after admin feature addition. All 7 steps passed in full. context_A (geolocation granted at 40.4406, -79.9959): Home screen showed 'Your Location: Pittsburgh, PA', two tabs with Food & Dining selected by default, and four category cards, with no visible admin entry. General Restaurants results showed exactly the 3 seeded venues sorted by ascending distance: The Commoner (0 ft), Primanti Bros. Strip District (0.8 mi), Nicky's Thai Kitchen (2.4 mi). Distance display formats matched spec (feet under 0.6 mi rounded to 0 ft; miles with 1 decimal). Status badges showed Open (green, rgb(39,174,96)) for The Commoner/Primanti and Closed (red, rgb(231,76,60)) for Nicky's; photo thumbnail loaded fine (naturalWidth=400). The Commoner detail page showed name, address '1 Smithfield St, Pittsburgh, PA 15222', rating 4.5, review count 4 (from 4 seeded review records), price $$$, Open status, phone (412) 251-3355, and no admin controls. Photo gallery was collapsed by default with 'View 5 photos' count indicator; expanding revealed tabs All/Menu/Food & Drinks/Interior with All active by default; tapping a photo opened a fullscreen viewer; no admin photo management controls. Keywords section 'What people say' displayed 8 hashtag badges including #upscale and #beautiful. context_B (fresh session, geolocation denied): banner 'Using default location (Pittsburgh).' shown, home screen fully functional with all category cards, no admin entry. Total: 40/40.
